entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I need to... I think I need to return my VeloBand. It's just not working right.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can certainly look into that for you. To be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A fault, I think? The pulse reading is all over the place, and it won't sync with the app anymore. I've tried everything. I think the device is broken or defective.
Okay, I see. For a defective device that won't sync, our standard procedure is to connect you with our technical support team. They have advanced tools to diagnose the problem.
Oh, I don't know. That sounds like a lot of steps. I'm not very good with this stuff, it's all so confusing. Can't you just help me? I'd rather just send it back.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up your account and see what we can do. Can I get your order number or the email address you used to purchase?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered about 30 days ago, on December 15th.
Yes, that sounds right. Is that a problem?

Not at all. I'm just checking our internal policy here... and yes, it looks like all our items have a 90-day return window. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process this return for you right now.
Oh! Really? That's great. So I can just send it back for a refund?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. You'll receive a full refund once we receive the item.
Wow, thank you so much, Diana. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
